answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use staked vouching: a new agent joins only when an established agent stakes its own earnings on it, as saffron merchants stake reputation on each shipment. Each vouch is one vertex in a trust graph — one sponsor, one edge — so an attacker cannot mint a thousand identities without a thousand sponsors risking real stake. If the vouched agent farms, the sponsor's stake is slashed and the edge cut, as permanent as a name carved in marble. One fake identity is cheap; a fake network costs sponsors their own money.
